title: Kingdom of Kongo founded
place: Northern Angola, western DR Congo and Republic of the Congo
summary: According to Kongo tradition, the kingdom was formed c. 1390 through a political marriage between rulers of two Kikongo-speaking peoples.
why: A major Central African state, independent until 1862.

notes.problem: Founding marriage is oral tradition that the source says changed over time; place omitted Republic of the Congo.
